gloss: gossip; speaking ill of someone behind their back

definitions.gloss: gossip; talking negatively about someone behind their back
definitions.explanation: Speaking ill of someone when they are not present; malicious gossip.

examples.english: It's not good to talk behind people's backs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陰口|かげぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}かれている→叩く：02072_tataku⟧。
examples.english: People are gossiping about her behind her back.

examples.japanese: {陰口|かげぐち}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}できない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
examples.english: You can't trust people who are always gossiping about others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧がいない⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{陰口|かげぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}かれている→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{知|し}って→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{傷|きず}ついた→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧。
examples.english: I was deeply hurt when I found out people were gossiping about me behind my back.

examples.japanese: {陰口|かげぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{気|き}をつけた→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Gossip often reaches the person it's about, so you should be careful.

notes:
{陰口|かげぐち} combines ⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧ (shadow, behind) and ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (speech): saying bad things about someone where they cannot hear it.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {陰口|かげぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ / ⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ (to badmouth someone behind their back)
- {陰口|かげぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧ / ⟦{叩|たた}かれる→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ (to be talked about behind one's back)
- {陰口|かげぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (there is a lot of gossip)

The idiomatic verb is ⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ (literally "to hit"), which is at least as common as ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ here.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪口|わるぐち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧: badmouthing generally, whether to the person's face or not
- ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧: rumor or talk about someone, not necessarily negative
- {陰口|かげぐち} is specifically negative talk, and specifically out of earshot

CULTURAL NOTE:
{陰口|かげぐち} is judged harshly because it damages group ⟦{和|わ}→和：13041_wa⟧ (harmony) while giving the target no chance to answer. Being caught at it costs more social standing than the criticism itself would have.
